title: Linux for Hackers
tagline: Master the operating system that powers 90% of the internet and every hacking tool
description: Every serious security professional lives in the Linux terminal. This course takes you from zero — what even is a file system — to confidently navigating, scripting, and manipulating Linux systems the way penetration testers do. Hands-on from day one.
learningObjectives: Navigate the Linux file system with confidence
Manage files, directories, and permissions from the command line
Write practical Bash scripts to automate security tasks
Use core networking tools: netstat, ss, nmap, curl
Understand process management and privilege escalation concepts
Set up a personal hacking lab on Linux
author: Cyber Learn Team
